evidence: The text states: 'Atomic layer deposition (ALD) of lanthanum oxide on glass and silicon substrates was examined using lanthanum silylamide, La[N(SiMe3)2]3, and water as precursors... Lanthanum aluminum oxide films were achieved with stoichiometry close to that of LaAlO3 at 225 °C from La[N(SiMe3)2]3, Al(CH3)3, and H2O... Some reference LaAlOx films were grown using the lanthanum b-diketonate, La(thd)3, as lanthanum precursor.'
